name: Speech
overview: Scripture reveals the profound importance of speech as a reflection of the heart and a means to honor God. The psalmist prays that both words and thoughts be pleasing to the Lord, recognizing speech as an expression of inner meditation and wisdom. The righteous speak with discernment and understanding, while God’s watchful care is sought to guard the lips from harmful words. Proverbs underscores the fear of the Lord as a motivation to reject evil speech, embracing gentle answers that promote peace rather than harsh words that provoke anger.
